question: The radius of a circle is equal to the side of a square. The perimeters of the square and circle are in the ratio 7 : 11, then the ratio of the areas will be:(Use π = 22/7)
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of a circle (r) = Side of a square (a)

Ratio of perimeters of square and circle = 7 : 11

Use π = 22/7

**Formula used:**

Perimeter of a square = 4a

Perimeter of a circle = 2πr

Area of a square = a²

Area of a circle = πr²

**Calculation:**

Ratio of perimeters = (4a) ÷ (2πr) = 7 ÷ 11

Since a = r: ⇒ (4r) ÷ (2πr) = 7 ÷ 11

⇒ 2 ÷ π = 7 ÷ 11 

Ratio of areas = (a²) ÷ (πr²)

Since a = r 

Ratio of areas = (r²) ÷ (πr²) = 1 ÷ π

Using π = 22/7: ⇒ 1 ÷ (22/7) = 7 ÷ 22

**∴ The ratio of the areas is 7 : 22.**
